text.tspan: GRID NAMING: A–E = east–west lines at x 0.20/5.20/10.20/15.20/20.20 · 4 and 5 = lines y 25.10 / 28.10 (as on your R33 sheet). Everything sits inside the
existing slab (x −1.80…22.20); nothing added behind the slab.
FROZEN FOR FUTURE BUILD: S1 stair (x −1.80…3.20, y 30.10…32.80, outside the slab) and the lift (x −3.80…−1.80, y 27.90…29.80). Lift door opens east onto
the lobby; the 1.70 m passage x 0.20…1.90 links lobby ↔ S1 ↔ back-of-court aisle.
TOILETS AT THE LEFT END: the accessible WC is exactly between lines 4–5, left of A; Female and Male WC follow immediately east of the passage. Cubicles
on the north wall, basins + vestibule at the door side.
LOCKER ROOMS: dry zone (lockers/bench) from the aisle on the south, wet zone (3 showers each) on the north with a wet door out to the pool deck. CLINIC
takes the old BOULDER slot; SPARE room takes the old storage slot.
ASSUMPTIONS TO CONFIRM: (1) the Boulder room (4.9×4.9) is moved to level 2/3 — ground floor cannot hold boulder + clinic + spare + 2 lockers + gift shop;
(2) clinic 23.5 m² = reception + 2 exam rooms (rehab/balance room moves to L2 Wellness);
(3) fixtures are schematic: sanitary counts ≈ your R33 (F 3 WC/2 basins, M 2 WC/1 U/2 basins, 3 showers per locker) · fire exits, plumbing risers/gravity
drains and ventilation still to be checked (concept layout, not construction drawings).
